entities.summary: Anita Natacha Akide, professionally known as Symply Tacha, is a media personality, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. She has appeared on the show Big Brother Naija as a housemate and also on MTV's The Challenge: Spies, Lies & Allies. She has won the awards like Net Honour's Most Popular Person, Female Personality of The Year, Celebrity Entrepreneur of the year and many more. She was the brand ambassador of GetFit, a Fitness brand
